entity: HathiTrust Research Center Analytics (HTRC, HTRC Analytics, analytics.hathitrust.org): the research center established in 2011 as a partnership between Indiana University, the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and HathiTrust, dedicated to enabling computational analysis of the HathiTrust Digital Library, and its analytics portal (worksets, algorithms, data capsules, derived datasets) under a non-consumptive use research policy; services ended 30 September 2026, the center formally closing at the end of 2026; formalized in the traininglayerliterature.org layer census record of 2026-11-01 (https://www.traininglayerliterature.org/aggregators/htrc)

classes.term: receiving apparatus: a machine reading of texts that emits an artifact (the census's organizing category for its rows)
classes.basis: archive: the census's tll_reading for the entity ('The archive reads HTRC as an earlier receiving apparatus with its product on record'; census.json rows[slug == 'htrc'].tll_reading) and its organizing question ('How is literature addressed to a receiving apparatus, what does that apparatus make from it'; census.json organizing_question); #1543 §8 and §10 (the census's anchor) define the receiving apparatus and its emission.

classes_note: Three classes, each sourced by locus: (1) non-consumptive computational analysis of library volumes (field B2, B5, B6; census kind, method, question); (2) derived datasets, the published product of a machine reading of volumes (field B2, B6; census unit, holdings, record.makes, tll_reading); (3) receiving apparatus (the census's own tll_reading and organizing question, archive by locus; its anchor #1543 §8, §10). The census places the entity in its area 'corpora' ('The corpora: collections, crawls and datasets whose texts enter machine training'; census.json areas, rows[slug == 'htrc'].areas) while its record.in_layer says 'the saved sources say nothing of model training'; the anchors #186 (the layer where texts are crawled, indexed, trained on, retrieved and recomposed) and #1543 (machine reception and composition) are read at the passages on corpora, machine reading and the receiving apparatus. The aliases are the entity's names and host. HathiTrust and the HathiTrust Digital Library (the parent partnership and the corpus, a row of their own in the census, hathitrust) are distinct entities and are not aliases; a sentence that names HathiTrust alone is about the library. The census's tll_reading is the archive's reading, ledgered as TLL-NN. Admission by reading (§3.4): D where a deposit names the entity and says something of it; R where it states a relation between the entity and an archive object; O-class where a sentence applies an archive category to one of the three classes; a bare mention or a catalogue line is not a claim.
